mapper.select: SELECT s.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name FROM t_shop s LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON s.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON s.tenant_id = t.id WHERE s.id = #{id}

SELECT s.*, o.name AS owner_name, t.name AS tenant_name FROM t_shop s LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON s.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_tenant t ON s.tenant_id = t.id
AND (s.shop_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%'))
AND s.status = #{status}
ORDER BY s.shop_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_shop (shop_no, area, owner_id, tenant_id, monthly_rent, business_scope, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{shopNo}, #{area}, #{ownerId}, #{tenantId}, #{monthlyRent}, #{businessScope}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rented, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN monthly_rent ELSE 0 END), 2) AS totalRent FROM t_shop
